messages: Priya (Product): quick design review — sharing the updated Console mock for Compliance > Data settings. Focus areas: retention copy, region selector defaulting, encrypt/KMS label phrasing, audit log event wording (timestamps/timezones), and keyboard/focus order for accessibility. Can we do microcopy + a11y sweep? Will (Design): looks good overall. two copy ideas for the encryption row — current label feels vague. my suggestion: ``` Managed by Redwood — Keys created, stored, and rotated by Redwood. No key material shared. Customer-managed (BYOK) — You provide a KMS key; Redwood never exports key material. ``` short tooltip: "Choose who controls the encryption keys for your data." :thinking_face: Jae (Frontend): a11y nit: screen readers read the colon awkwardly when we do "Encryption: Managed by Redwood". recommend using an aria-label on the status element instead of relying on visible punctuation. e.g. `span aria-label="Encryption status: Managed by Redwood"` and mark dynamic status with `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"`. also for the retention slider add `aria-describedby` pointing to the help text. Marta (Security): +1 on BYOK wording. security notes: do NOT render full KMS ARNs in the list view — mask them like `arn:aws:kms:...:abc123...` or show only last 8 chars. audit logs must not contain key material or raw ARNs unless the user explicitly requests a detailed export (and then gated). retention wording: avoid ambiguous verbs — use "Permanently delete data after X days" not just "Delete after X days". Tom (Eng-Platform): keyboard/focus ordering: region dropdown should come before retention because region affects available defaults (e.g., some regions have different retention limits for compliance). filing a small PR to move DOM order and update the tab-index. reproduce note: open Console -> Compliance -> Data, tab once to reach region, tab again to reach retention; currently broken on Safari 15 (issue #432). Will (Design): small copy tweak for audit events — current: "Data deleted" -> change to "Data permanently deleted" and add context: "(retention policy)" when applicable. for timestamp display: show local time by default and hover/tooltip shows UTC. keep entries short in the list, expand in the detail flyout. Jae (Frontend): code snippet for screen reader label we can push quickly: ` Managed by Redwood ` also adding `aria-describedby=\"retention-help\"` to the slider. will open PR after copy is final. Marta (Security): audit log timestamp decision: prefer storing UTC server-side; show localized time in UI with an explicit timezone abbreviation (e.g., "2026-03-23 14:32 PDT"). if we allow toggling, default to local. also add a "reason" field to retention-deletion events: e.g., "automated retention (policy id: X)" — helps audits. A11yBot: automated scan results: 1) Contrast fail on blue encrypt badge (contrast ratio 2.9:1) — WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text. 2) Missing `:focus-visible` outline on region dropdown on keyboard navigation. 3) Retention slider missing accessible name / `aria-describedby`. See https://a11y.report/scan/1964123456 for details. Tom (Eng-Platform): noted re Safari issue — adding label to issue tracker and will attach steps & console logs. also we should avoid reflow when toggling encryption status; prefer CSS transform for animate. Will (Design): one more microcopy thought for the KMS row in the table: show a compact hint below the row: "BYOK — Managed in your KMS" and on hover show full explanation. keeps list scannable. :memo: Priya (Product): great feedback — action items: Will update copy suggestions and tooltip text; Jae to push aria-label + aria-describedby PR; Marta to add masking rules + audit event phrasing; Tom to file PR for DOM order + Safari repro; A11yBot to re-run scan after PRs. can everyone ack when you claim? :white_check_mark: Will (Design): acked. Jae (Frontend): claiming aria PR now. Marta (Security): claiming masking + audit text updates. Tom (Eng-Platform): claiming DOM ordering PR. A11yBot: scheduled re-scan in 24h after changes. Priya (Product): thanks all — will follow up in the design doc with updated mock and paste the final copy snippets. :party:
